overlap.rationale_zh: 与 1.1.1 睡眠核心项为同一指标；荟萃分析各研究校正不一，只确定校正年龄、性别，系数压到 0.3

population.cohort: dose-response meta-analysis of 67 prospective cohort articles
population.events_source_zh: 全文 Results 第一段：total of 3 582 016 participants, including 241 107 cases of all-cause mortality

evidence.quote: For all-cause mortality, when sleep duration was <7 hours per day, the pooled relative risk (RR) was 1.06 (95% CI, 1.04-1.07) per 1-hour reduction; when sleep duration was >7 hours per day, the pooled RR was 1.13 (95% CI, 1.11-1.15) per 1-hour increment.
evidence.estimand_zh: 观察性前瞻队列的剂量-反应荟萃 RR（非因果）：自述睡眠时长在 7 小时以下每减少 1 小时、7 小时以上每增加 1 小时的全因死亡相对危险。东亚合并队列（PMID 34477853）只给分类 HR，不能折成斜率，故不选；非东亚为主，已收缩
